name: local
label: Local tracker
docs: Bundled local tracker: the agile-backlog-toolkit's Tickets/ folder at the project root. Each work item is a ticket file (Markdown, the toolkit's front matter, the description as its body) in Tickets/Ready, Tickets/InProgress or Tickets/Done; a file without provider_id is a draft. Artifacts go to Tickets/Attachments/<KEY>/ and sprint capacity to capacity-<sprint>.json beside Tickets/. No provider onboarding is needed.
